en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large military drill ground in front of a long barracks‑like building with a central arched entrance topped by a clock. Soldiers in uniform are standing in formation and walking in small groups across the open field. Trees line the edge of the parade ground, and the architecture appears early 20th‑century European. Printed text runs along the bottom edge and a red number is handwritten at the top right.
